description: Create a frontend component that allows users to connect their Outlook 365 calendar to the platform. This component should handle the OAuth authentication flow for Microsoft Graph API and provide a user interface for initiating and managing the connection. The implementation should follow the same patterns as existing calendar connection atoms like Google Calendar.
functional_requirements: Build a React component that renders a connect button and handles the OAuth flow for Outlook 365 using Microsoft Graph API credentials
Implement proper state management for connection status (connected/disconnected) with visual feedback to users
Follow the existing platform atom architecture patterns for consistency with other calendar integrations
Include error handling for authentication failures and connection issues with appropriate user messages
Ensure the component works within the examples app for testing with environment variables for client ID and secret
Maintain separation of concerns by keeping business logic in hooks and presentation in the component
